name: Kawano Satsuki
source:
A schoolgirl whom Takuma has been tutoring. Satsuki still longs for him and persistently calls him "Sesa-sensei".

[Partially translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20160415123521/http://www.eants.co.jp/game/question/index.html]official DVDPG version homepage at Eants[/url].]
